title: 预填充到自回归的跨模型迁移：机遇与挑战
summary: 本文提出开源框架PLatour，通过零初始化线性桥接连接冻结的大模型与小模型，实现预填充到自回归的跨模型迁移（PACT）。实验显示其在生成任务上优于开源基线，但受控实验表明部分增益可被无信息信号或仅训练接收方复现，因此提出PACT-Check以量化真实通信带来的增益。
summary_en: The paper introduces PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that links frozen large and small models via zero-initialized linear bridges trained with task rewards. It outperforms open-source baselines, but controlled experiments show some gains are reproducible with uninformative sender signals or receiver-only training, so the authors propose PACT-Check to quantify genuine communication gains.
